title: Protection required.
officialText:
Protective shield plates shall be placed where nails or screws from finish or other work are likely to
penetrate the clothes dryer exhaust duct. Shield plates shall be placed on the finished face of all framing members where there is less
than 1¼ inches (32 mm) between the duct and the finished face of the framing member. Protective shield plates shall be constr ucted
of steel, have a thickness of 0.062 inch (1.6 mm) and extend a minimum of 2 inches (51 mm) above sole plates and below top plates.
